app.name: ADCB
app.note: Combines two app generations: the new ADCB. app (April 2026 onward) and the previous ADCB app (2012 to 2026).

new.releaseNotes:
Introducing a new era of banking with the new ADCB Mobile Banking App. Powered by AI. Shaped by you.

- AI-powered smart banking with intuitive prompts across services
- Faster, more seamless experience across accounts, cards, loans and services
- Intuitive end-to-end journeys, redesigned to be simpler and clearer
- All-in-one app to manage banking, products and investments
- Investment and trading with access to US equities, ETFs and cryptocurrencies

This is just the beginning and we are continuously improving your experience. Keep your app up to date to enjoy the latest features and enhancements.
